newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets quiet, watching dollar.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets quiet, watching dollar.

text.p: European raw cotton markets saw little action on Monday as traders monitored the impact on forex movements of the Group of Seven pronouncement on the U.S. dollar, industry sources said.
Early indications suggested that cotton prices in Europe would shift upwards, offering further incentive for buyers to stay aloof, they said.

With New York futures rangebound and most mills already covered for nearby requirements and showing no interest in buying more than two months ahead, the market was extremely quiet, they reported. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
